title: CoinShares Debunks Tether Collapse Fears After Hayes Warning
summary: CoinShares head of research James Butterfill has rejected insolvency concerns surrounding Tether following warnings from BitMEX founder Arthur Hayes, pointing to over $181 billion in reserves against $174 billion liabilities with a $6.78 billion surplus.
